|damage = 60-80 |csc = .02 |stats = {{Name|Speed w|+4}} |gprice = 50000 |value = 650 }} The '''Galaxy Sword''' is a [[Weapons#Sword|sword weapon]] that can be obtained by taking a [[Prismatic Shard]] to the [[The Desert#Three Pillars|Three Pillars]] in [[The Desert|the Calico Desert]]. While holding the shard, enter the centermost tile between the three pillars. The Prismatic Shard will be consumed. The Galaxy Sword will not be "lost" upon the players' health being reduced to 0 in the mines. After obtaining a Galaxy Sword, players will not be able to use a Prismatic Shard to obtain another. If lost or sold, another sword may be purchased from [[Marlon]] for {{Price|50000}}. Obtaining a Galaxy Sword unlocks the [[Galaxy Hammer]] and [[Galaxy Dagger]] in the [[Adventurer's Guild]] shop. The Galaxy Sword can be combined with {{Name|Galaxy Soul|3|class=inline}} and {{Name|Cinder Shard|60|class=inline}} in the [[Forge]] to create an {{Name|Infinity Blade|class=inline}}. ==Hint== A hint about how to obtain the Galaxy Sword can be found by reading the [[Graveyard#Dwarvish Headstone|Dwarvish headstone]] in the [[Graveyard]]. The hint will be in Dwarvish until the player obtains the [[Dwarvish Translation Guide]]. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.1|After obtaining the sword, it can be purchased from [[Marlon]]. Now unlocks the [[Galaxy Hammer]] and [[Galaxy Dagger]] for purchase.}} {{History|1.4|Fixed bug allowing [[wallpaper]] #75 to be used in place of a [[Prismatic Shard]] at the Three Pillars. Fixed bug where the entire stack of Prismatic Shards would be consumed at the Three Pillars.}} {{History|1.5|Can now be changed into an [[Infinity Blade]].
